description: Use for the latest tracked coin prices, market caps and 24-hour volume; returns no news. Call list_supported_coins for the tracked coins. A snapshot batch of all tracked coins with prices, market caps, volume and rank where available: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: coin: optional case-insensitive tracked ticker; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins; format: compact or omit for full fields. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

coin.description: Optional tracked coin symbol such as BTC, ETH or DOGE; leave it out to get every tracked coin. Only tracked coins are accepted; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins.

format.description: Optional compact view: retain selected headline or market fields and omit other fields. Omit for the full response.

name: get_market_snapshot
